name: ネオン・サイバーパンク
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.6)); margin: 0 !important; }

#roulette-svg-target { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.95), rgba(5, 5, 15, 1)); border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #00ffff; box-shadow: 0 0 30px #00ffff, inset 0 0 50px rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.2); transition: transform 0.1s; }

.cyber-grid { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.1) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 50px 50px; animation: gridScroll 20s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; }

.neon-glow-bg { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.15), transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%, rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.15), transparent 50%); animation: glowPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; }

.floating-particles { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background-image: radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20% 30%, #00ffff, transparent), radial-gradient(2px 2px at 60% 70%, #ff00ff, transparent), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 50% 50%, #00ff00, transparent), radial-gradient(2px 2px at 80% 10%, #ffff00, transparent), radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90% 60%, #00ffff, transparent); background-size: 200% 200%; background-position: 0% 0%; animation: particleFloat 15s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; }

.hologram-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 500px; height: 500px; border: 2px solid rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.3); border-radius: 50%; animation: holoRing 3s linear infinite; pointer-events: none; }

@keyframes holoRing { 0% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); opacity: 0.5; } 50% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.05); opacity: 0.8; } 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); opacity: 0.5; } }

.scan-line { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #00ffff, transparent); animation: scanMove 2s linear infinite; opacity: 0.7; pointer-events: none; }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 60px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 20px solid transparent; border-right: 20px solid transparent; border-top: 40px solid #ff00ff; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 15px #ff00ff); animation: pointerGlow 1s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; z-index: 100; }
/* ▼▼▼ 修正: ボタンらしいデザインに変更 ▼▼▼ */
/* フレックスボックスで文字を中央揃え */
pointer-events: none; /* 文字がクリックを邪魔しないように */
margin-left: 4px; /* 見た目のバランス調整 */

#result { position: absolute; top: 650px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); font-size: 32px; font-weight: bold; color: #00ffff; text-shadow: 0 0 20px #00ffff, 0 0 40px #ff00ff; animation: resultFlicker 0.5s ease-in-out infinite; width: 100%; text-align: center; z-index: 100; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #00ffff !important; color: #00ffff !important; }
